description.text: Bavland is a self-governing region at the foot of a mountain range, technically inside the borders of southwestern Jah Keved. With a town square, a few hundred homes and three taverns, Ironsway is one of its biggest settlements.
Szeth still thinks of it as a village. Like many Bavland towns, it has a large population of workers who come and go with the ups and downs of the local mines.

items.text: Took brought Szeth into a shabby tavern in Ironsway to show him off to local miners, among them Amark and Ton.
Leaving the tavern, Took headed for the town's poor district to avoid paying for better lodgings. Thieves killed him in the street and took Szeth's Oathstone.
